protocol.execution: local CPU, two month batches in parallel on distinct physical P cores; sequential controllers within each month
protocol.forecast: perfect dataset values for at most next 24 hours, clipped at episode end
protocol.terminal_policy: MPC: stationary energy >= 50% physical capacity; EV announced target, lexicographic feasible service. No Community terminal states in controller.
protocol.timing: Common Runtime/predict_seconds on every step, includes agent processing and common input conversion/capture; excludes simulator stepping and final export. No policy training.
protocol.oracle: Retain historical weekly oracle; prepare an additional weekly oracle matched to MPC actual terminal energy after final runs, without feeding it into MPC.
protocol.evidence_horizon: 14 days, independent resets, not annual or global Simulator optimum
protocol.measured_energy: Preserve physical energy below discharge reserve after standby loss; require restoration through charge, no clamping to reserve
protocol.host_load: Two benchmark P cores, validation tests concurrently on E cores during part of the measurements; not isolated microbenchmarks.

baseline: NormalTargetPolicy with BESS and user target
evidence_horizon: 14 days, two independently reset weeks; no annual or global Simulator optimality claim

peak_diagnostic.method: Charger export uses -1 as absent directional-flow sentinel; sum nonnegative charger consumption only. Core30 V2G is disabled. Residual is remaining building demand, not an independently audited appliance breakdown.

validation.gpu_diagnostic: An accidental GPU-visible suite had two existing CPU/CUDA tensor test failures and one MADDPG resume reproducibility failure. CPU suites, matching CI, were rerun successfully; GPU behaviour is not certified by this campaign.
